critical_terminology_check.clause: GDN is trained on normal data
critical_terminology_check.reason: The frozen passing path authorizes exactly the P1 NORMAL_CANDIDATE_FIT train1/train2 feature view, rejects labels, attacks, train3, train4, and test inputs, and the committed execution receipt records only train1/train2 access.

critical_terminology_check.clause: Node-embedding-based learned graph edges are used as candidate relationship rankings
critical_terminology_check.reason: Each trained seed recomputes cosine similarity from the best-state node embeddings, takes per-target learned-graph Top-5 neighbors, projects those edges to the frozen 144-pair source-target universe, and ranks supported pairs across three seeds by selection frequency then median embedding cosine similarity.

critical_terminology_check.clause: Attention coefficients themselves are not used as final relationship evidence
critical_terminology_check.reason: GraphLayer computes attention for message passing and stores a private alpha trace, but the candidate extraction and ranking paths read embedding weights, cosine similarities, and learned-graph indices only. The result contract rejects attention_used_for_primary_ranking=true.

critical_terminology_check.clause: No separate post-hoc XAI method is used
critical_terminology_check.reason: The passing result records posthoc_xai_used=false, the result contract rejects post-hoc XAI as the TASK-039C-GDN method, and no SHAP or other post-hoc attribution path is called by the frozen runner.

port_adapters: sparse softmax keyword binding preserving upstream num_nodes semantics

training_data_boundary.preprocessing: raw numeric values with no scaling; sliding windows never cross input files
training_data_boundary.segment_handling: train1 and train2 are loaded as separate segments before window construction

prediction_objective.input_representation: node-major five-step history for each of 37 P1 features
prediction_objective.training_target: the immediately following value for every modeled feature
prediction_objective.model_output: one next-value forecast per modeled feature
prediction_objective.loss: mean MSE over the multi-node next-value forecast

node_embeddings.construction: one trainable nn.Embedding vector per modeled feature
node_embeddings.optimization: jointly optimized through next-value prediction loss
node_embeddings.interpretation: learned model parameters supporting forecasting and graph construction; not physical or causal relation truth

learned_graph.construction: embedding dot-product matrix divided by outer L2 norms, followed by torch.topk on each target row
learned_graph.edge_tensor_semantics: first row is source-neighbor indices; second row is repeated target indices
learned_graph.self_neighbor_handling: The upstream Top-5 calculation does not explicitly remove the cosine diagonal before Top-K. Projection to the disjoint source-role by target-role universe removes self identities from exported candidates; GraphLayer separately removes and re-adds message-passing self-loops.
learned_graph.candidate_universe_projection: Only learned edges that are members of the frozen 12-by-12 directed source-target universe are retained as selected candidate edges.
learned_graph.interpretation: per-target learned neighbor/input-dependency candidate edge, not a confirmed temporal or causal relation

graph_attention.role: model-internal weighting of messages on the embedding-derived learned graph
graph_attention.mechanism: feature and embedding keys produce LeakyReLU logits, destination-group softmax coefficients, dropout, and weighted source messages
graph_attention.attention_interpretation_prohibited: final relationship evidence, causal importance, or confirmed temporal direction

posthoc_xai_and_masking.current_frozen_candidate_masking: No pre-Top-K role mask or perturbation/masking experiment is used. The upstream full-context learned Top-5 graph is projected afterward to the frozen candidate universe.
posthoc_xai_and_masking.future_edge_or_source_masking: functional validation procedure only; not a fourth discovery arm and not performed in this audit

candidate_extraction_and_ranking.per_seed_selected_edge_rule: embedding learned-graph Top-5 edge survives frozen universe projection
candidate_extraction_and_ranking.per_seed_similarity_coverage: cosine similarity is retained for every one of the 144 frozen candidate pairs
candidate_extraction_and_ranking.successful_seed_requirement: all three seeds must complete or the result fails closed
cross_seed_evidence: median embedding cosine similarity across all three seeds
candidate_extraction_and_ranking.final_ranking_object: tuple of GDNCandidateEvidenceV1 stored in GDNCandidateResultV1 and serialized as the public ranking

learned_graph_topk.meaning: per-target embedding-neighbor count inside the GDN model

candidate_budget_topk.meaning: primary arm-level slice of the deterministic 39-pair GDN ranking
candidate_budget_topk.provenance: TASK-039C0 preregistered candidate budget before real arm outcomes

topk_distinction.substantive_primary_budget_rationale: RATIONALE_UNDOCUMENTED beyond the frozen primary and sensitivity-budget design

directionality.reason: Neighbor inclusion can be non-reciprocal under per-target Top-K, and the frozen role universe defines ordered source-target identities.
directionality.downstream_confirmation: normal delayed-response relation profiling establishes whether a candidate supports the frozen temporal relation family, horizon, and response evidence

training_and_checkpoint_policy.validation_policy: seeded contiguous random validation block over the generated window dataset
training_and_checkpoint_policy.deterministic_controls: Python and Torch seeds; CUDA seeds when available; cuDNN benchmark disabled and deterministic enabled
training_and_checkpoint_policy.checkpoint_policy: best finite validation-loss state_dict retained in memory

implementation_claims.claim: The system implements and executed an upstream-aligned GDN learned-graph candidate source on the frozen normal P1 view.
GDN attention coefficients are the candidate-ranking authority.
A separate post-hoc XAI or SHAP method generates GDN candidates.
GDN edges are confirmed temporal or causal process relations.
GDN supplies unique useful relations or improves downstream detection.

key_functions.role: fail-closed P1 train1/train2 normal-only access gate
load only approved ordered finite numeric columns as separate file segments
freeze seeds, model, optimization, validation, preprocessing, and device settings
attention-weighted message passing on learned graph edges
construct embedding cosine Top-5 graph and forecast the next node values
create per-file five-step histories and one-step-ahead targets
train one frozen seed, restore best state, and extract learned graph plus all-pair similarities
project full-context learned graph edges to the exact 144 directed pairs
aggregate the three seed graphs and create deterministic evidence ranking
slice one ranking into Top-10, Top-20, and Top-40 without padding
one-shot frozen real execution orchestration and private/public custody

test_evidence.reason: This agent performed a read-only audit and relied on frozen public execution/audit evidence; no GDN code was executed.

limitations_and_future_validation.item: Three-seed selection frequency is present, but broader seed and split stability has not been established.
The scientific usefulness of GDN-only candidates after downstream confirmation remains unvalidated.
Edge/source masking functional impact was not measured in the frozen arm and remains a future validation procedure.
Optional attention analysis may describe model behavior but cannot retroactively become the frozen primary ranking method.
The learned-graph Top-5 includes upstream self-neighbor semantics before universe projection; sensitivity to that architecture choice was not tested here.

mismatch_findings.finding: Any current-facing description that says attention weights directly rank or explain the frozen GDN candidate relationships is contradicted by the production extraction path.
Any description of a GDN candidate edge as a confirmed temporal direction or causal process relation overstates the source evidence.
The generic project-owned masked GDN extraction module is not the frozen TASK-039C GDN production backend.
mismatch_findings.recommended_wording: the frozen arm uses upstream learned Top-5 graph extraction followed by universe projection

mismatch_findings.finding: Historical blocked and failed GDN attempts remain in reports, but the later independently audited GDNP result is the current frozen authority.
mismatch_findings.recommended_wording: distinguish preserved history from the passing superseding result

professor_answer_basis.current_method: Normal P1 train1/train2 next-value forecasting trains per-variable embeddings; embedding cosine Top-5 learned-graph edges are projected and aggregated into candidate evidence.
professor_answer_basis.attention_role: Attention weights messages inside the GDN forecast model but is not the final candidate-ranking or explanation authority.
professor_answer_basis.xai: No separate post-hoc XAI or SHAP method is used in the frozen discovery arm.
professor_answer_basis.edge_meaning: A learned neighbor/input-dependency candidate for a target, not temporal causality.
professor_answer_basis.final_temporal_relation: Established only downstream, if at all, through normal delayed-response relation profiling and confirmation.
professor_answer_basis.unvalidated_contribution: Whether GDN adds stable, uniquely confirmed, scientifically useful relations beyond META/STAT.
